messages:
sarah.yang: Hey team — Veridian is ready to spin up the Private POC in their VPC. They require HSM-backed keys and a cert handshake. Can we confirm the steps for the cert exchange and any entitlement we need to enable on Dedicated/Private?

devon_se: Quick checklist: 1) We create a CSR for their HSM key (they own HSM). 2) They sign CSR and return cert + chain. 3) We need the cert in PEM, plus the customer CA chain. 4) Customer must add our service account to their VPC peering list.

mike.security: Add: we must confirm key usage and EK (attestation) policy for HSM. For BYOK over HSM we only store public cert + thumbprint, private key stays with customer HSM. We also need the KMS ARN (or HSM identifier) and the signing algorithm.

james.veridian: Confirming we will provide signed certs and EK info. Our security team prefers mutual TLS and key rotation guidance. ETA: certs by EOD tomorrow.

sarah.yang: Great. Devon, can you draft the CSR template and rotation instructions to share? Keep minimal fields: CN=redwood-inference, O=Veridian-Prod, SANs=*.veridian.internal

devon_se: Drafted and pasted below:

```
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
MIIBVTCB... (truncated example)
-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
```

Include these fields: subjectAltName, keyUsage: digitalSignature,keyEncipherment, extendedKeyUsage: serverAuth, clientAuth. Also include how to compute thumbprint: `openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -inform pem -in cert.pem`

mike.security: For onboarding, we need them to fill the mini-SQ on HSM integration: provider, module serial, attestation report (if available), allowed algorithms, rotation window. I can send the template.

sarah.yang: I'll loop in AE and update the POC runbook. James — once you send cert+chain and attestation, we will validate and provide ephemeral bootstrap token. Note: bootstrap token expires in 1 hour; production tokens use the customer's KMS-bound policy.

deploy-bot: [deployment] Private POC env created: poc-veridian-2026, resources: 2xA10G, VPC peering pending. Link: https://console.redwood/pocs/poc-veridian-2026

james.veridian: Uploading certs now to the secure upload link. Also attaching attestation report. Thanks — will follow rotation plan once validated.
